entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hi... I'm calling because I need to make a return. I'm just so disappointed, I really hoped this would work out.
Hi, you've reached VeloFit, my name is Alex. I'm sorry to hear that. I can definitely look into this return for you. To get started, could I please have your name and order number?
It's Sarah Miller, and the order number is... VF77819. I've been a loyal customer for years, and I really needed this money back... I feel so bad having to call.

I understand, Sarah. Thank you for that information. I've pulled up your order for the VeloBand Cadence Sensor. Just to make sure I'm helping you in the best way possible, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

It's just... it's not for me. And I tried to do the return on your website yesterday, but there was a huge website error. The whole system must have been down. I even took a screenshot of the error page.
I see. And you were trying to generate the return label?
Yes, exactly. I couldn't print the label or even get to the final page. I was so worried because I know there are return windows and it wasn't my fault.

You are absolutely right to call in. I'm very sorry for that trouble. Let me just check something on my end... Yes, it looks like we did have a known service outage yesterday that affected our returns portal. I sincerely apologize for that inconvenience.
Let me pull up the policy for your VeloBand. Okay, I see you received the item on December 27th. Our policy allows for returns within 90 days of delivery, so you are well within that timeframe.
Oh, 90 days? That's... oh, that's such a relief. I was so worried about being just a day late.

Not at all. I can absolutely process this return for you right now. I'll email you a new return label immediately. Once we receive the item back at our warehouse, we'll issue a full refund to your original payment method.
Oh, thank you! That's wonderful news. You have no idea how much I appreciate this, Alex. I was so stressed about it.
You're very welcome, Sarah. I'm glad I could resolve this for you. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
My pleasure. Have a great day and thank you for calling VeloFit.
